title: Compose 2D transformations
summary: Build rotation, scaling and shear matrices, compose them in the order that you apply them, and apply a matrix to a set of points.

mutants.compose_reversed: Multiplies the matrices in the wrong order, so the last transformation is applied first.
mutants.rotation_clockwise: Uses the transposed rotation matrix, which turns the points clockwise.
mutants.apply_without_transpose: Computes points times matrix, which applies the transposed matrix to each point.
mutants.shear_swapped: Puts kx and ky in the wrong places of the shear matrix.
